title: Pension schemes newsletter 184 — August 2026
text:
This newsletter is published by HMRC’s Pension Schemes Services to update stakeholders on the latest news for pension schemes

 Pension schemes newsletter 184 has articles on:

 • normal minimum pension age

 • non-statutory clearances

 • disposal of non-standard assets

 • low earner’s pension payment — update for pension scheme administrators

 • private pension statistics

 • pension savings statements

 • defined benefit pension scheme surplus payments to members
